Method of Attack: Impersonation of well-known brands via over 42,000 fake web domains to redirect users to adware apps, dating sites, or fake giveaways
Redirecting victims through mobile ads or WhatsApp messages to survey domains with timers to create urgency
Downloading apps that require risky permissions and serve intrusive ads
Referral registration via app launch and open time
Use of suspicious advertisements (ylliX) leading to further redirection chains
Redirection paths leading to Triada trojan downloads, fake dating sites, SMS micropayment scams, and affiliate links
Attack Vector: Fake giveaway and survey websites using various TLDs (.top, .cn, .cyou, .xyz, .work, .tech)
Indicators of Compromise: Domains registered via GoDaddy, Namecheap, Wix
App Booster Lite – RAM Booster app on Play Store by LocoMind
Shared IP address between LocoMind and Holacode
